name: wp-ja-kinetic/kinetic-pagination
title: Kinetic pagination
description: The source's Joomla core pagination widget (`Pagination::getPagesLinks()`/`getPagesCounter()`, a Bootstrap `.pagination` list with first/prev/next/last Lucide chevrons plus a "Page X of Y" counter) instead of core WordPress's own `query-pagination` block markup. Reused by every listing/archive template this overlay owns.

counterFirst.description: com_tags/tag/default.php:51-58 renders the counter BEFORE the links (every other view this block is used on renders links then counter).
